+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+            "messages": [

+                {"role": "user", "content": f"Translate this text to {target_language}: {text}"},
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )

+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )

+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
